ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given points $C$ and $D$ are on the line segment $AB$, where $AB=22$ and $CD=8$. If point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, find the length of $BD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=22$ and $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
it follows that $BC=11$,\\
Since $CD=8$,\\
it follows that $BD=BC-CD=\boxed{3}$.
